name: Press Release
content: *Subheadline: one sentence expanding the headline with the key detail or number.*
**CITY, State — {date}** — Lead paragraph. Who is announcing what, when, and why it matters. A reader who stops here should still have the whole story.
Second paragraph: the most important supporting detail — the problem this addresses, the number that proves it, or what changes for customers.
> "Quote from a named spokesperson with title. Say something a person would actually say, not a slogan."
Third paragraph: context — availability, pricing, timing, where to learn more.
About [Company]: two or three sentences that stay the same across releases.
*Checklist before sending: headline states news (not hype), lede answers who/what/when/why, every claim has a proof point, quote sounds human, 400–600 words total.*
